peg.volatility_score_basis: Longer-term assessment of the same Yahoo/yfinance STRC marks and $100 reference as the dashboard. Compatible source history: mean observed STRC price $99.23 over 30 days versus $97.25 over 90 days; latest 7-day mean $99.21. This credits recovery toward par, but repeated closed-market observations are not independent trades. Discretionary soft-floor policy and earlier substantial discounts limit confidence; par is not an ordinary holder redemption price. Held 5.0, not a spot-price score.
peg.volatility_score_persistence: filtered — anchor mechanism and realized draw, not a spot quote

liquidity.liquidity_score_basis: Raw STRC only: Nasdaq listing and normal brokerage access support Liquidity 7.0. The shared feed has no order-book/executable-size ladder, so no numerical impact or dollar-depth threshold is asserted. Do not import STRCx token-market depth or measure execution shortfall against par. Market execution uses prevailing market value; par behavior is evaluated separately. No newly measured stress-depth claim or liquidity improvement is inferred.
liquidity.liquidity_score_persistence: filtered — venue class and access, not spot depth
liquidity.liquidity_score_depth_caveat: ⚠️ NO 2% DEPTH LADDER APPLIES — this is an exchange-listed security, not a DEX pool, and no feed computes depth for it. The 7.0 rests on listing class and access, not on a probe.

redemption_note: ⚠️ A separate `redemption_score` of 5.0 exists and is not rendered through this envelope.
coverage_note: STRC report carries four instrument-specific axes: Volatility 5.0, Liquidity 7.0, Counterparty 3.0, Redemption 5.0. This envelope routes volatility/liquidity through the common frame and family overall through family_overalls. It does not imply that all four report axes already render in the dashboard. MSTR retains its separate issuer-dependency axes; do not substitute STRC axes.
routing_note: Current app resolves base feed by data_source and per-axis overlays by view slug. MSTR and STRCx reuse STRC base data but retain their own scope and authored scores. This envelope is authored for raw STRC, with explicitly labelled family_overalls; it must not create a par/volatility/liquidity assessment of MSTR common equity.
